auth.welcome: Please log in with your TU-ID.
auth.unavailable: The service cannot be reached right now. Your session is kept.
auth.expired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.

breakGlass.title: Emergency login
breakGlass.hint: Only for the break-glass account, when the TU-ID login is unavailable. Every attempt is recorded.
breakGlass.limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
breakGlass.unavailable: The service cannot be reached right now.

directory.truncated: There are more matches than shown. Please narrow the search.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.unavailable: The service cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.
errors.quota: Your storage space is used up.
errors.totalQuota: The storage space of this system is used up.
errors.unsupportedType: This file type is not accepted, or the file is not what its type says.

exports.title: My data
exports.explainOwn: Download everything this system holds about you, as a ZIP file with a JSON document and your files. It is prepared in the background and kept for a few days.
exports.failedHint: This export could not be prepared. Please request a new one.

gdpr.explain: Requests of data subjects: find the person by TU-ID, export their data to hand it over, or erase them.
gdpr.exportExplain: The export is available to you only. Hand it over to the person yourself.
gdpr.eraseExplain: Removes TU-ID, name, email and picture, deletes the person's documents and files and logs them out everywhere. The account remains only as an anonymous number in the activity log. This cannot be undone.
gdpr.notSelf: You cannot erase your own account.
gdpr.notBreakGlass: The break-glass account holds no personal data and cannot be erased.
